lines: The NBQ Infinite Card is an invitation-only credit card with special privileges, including Priority Pass airport lounge access, travel insurance, and hotel and travel discounts. It comes with a higher spending limit than our other cards, and up to 55 days free credit.
Use your card without PIN upto AED 500/-
Priority Pass Lounge access at over 1300 lounges in Various airports around the world
Get cashback on your shopping, with free credit for up to 55 days
Enjoy free airport lounge access and 50% off at major golf courses
